//go:build vless && reality

package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"crypto/rand"
	gotls "crypto/tls"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net"
	"net/netip"
	"os"
	"time"

	"github.com/onlymaj/v2ray-client-go/internal/outbound"
	_ "github.com/onlymaj/v2ray-client-go/internal/outbound/vless"
	"github.com/onlymaj/v2ray-client-go/internal/transport"
	_ "github.com/onlymaj/v2ray-client-go/internal/transport/reality"
	_ "github.com/onlymaj/v2ray-client-go/internal/transport/tls"
)

func listen(addr string, cfg *gotls.Config) {
	ln, err := net.Listen("tcp", addr)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	go func() {
		for {
			c, err := ln.Accept()
			if err != nil {
				return
			}
			go func() {
				defer c.Close()
				if cfg != nil {
					c = gotls.Server(c, cfg)
				}
				io.Copy(c, c)
			}()
		}
	}()
}

func run(name, layerName, layerSettings string, port int, vlessSettings string, dest int, innerTLS bool) {
	lf, _ := transport.Lookup(layerName)
	l, err := lf([]byte(layerSettings))
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println(name, "FAIL layer", err)
		return
	}
	of, _ := outbound.Lookup("vless")
	d, err := of([]byte(vlessSettings), func(ctx context.Context) (net.Conn, error) {
		c, err := net.Dial("tcp", fmt.Sprintf("127.0.0.1:%d", port))
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return l.Wrap(ctx, c)
	})
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println(name, "FAIL dialer", err)
		return
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 20*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	c, err := d.Dial(ctx, "tcp", outbound.Addr{IP: netip.MustParseAddr("127.0.0.1"), Port: uint16(dest)})
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println(name, "FAIL dial", err)
		return
	}
	defer c.Close()
	c.SetDeadline(time.Now().Add(20 * time.Second))
	var rw io.ReadWriter = c
	if innerTLS {
		tc := gotls.Client(c, &gotls.Config{InsecureSkipVerify: true, ServerName: "inner.test"})
		if err := tc.Handshake(); err != nil {
			fmt.Println(name, "FAIL inner handshake", err)
			return
		}
		rw = tc
	}
	data := make([]byte, 1<<20)
	rand.Read(data)
	go func() {
		for i := 0; i < len(data); i += 3000 {
			rw.Write(data[i:min(i+3000, len(data))])
		}
	}()
	got := make([]byte, len(data))
	if _, err := io.ReadFull(rw, got); err != nil {
		fmt.Println(name, "FAIL read", err)
		return
	}
	if !bytes.Equal(got, data) {
		fmt.Println(name, "FAIL mismatch")
		return
	}
	fmt.Println(name, "OK")
}

func main() {
	cert, err := gotls.LoadX509KeyPair(os.Args[1], os.Args[2])
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	listen("127.0.0.1:9443", &gotls.Config{Certificates: []gotls.Certificate{cert}, NextProtos: []string{"h2", "http/1.1"}})
	listen("127.0.0.1:9444", &gotls.Config{Certificates: []gotls.Certificate{cert}})
	listen("127.0.0.1:9445", nil)
	time.Sleep(200 * time.Millisecond)
	id := `"id":"f26364b7-5024-4ff5-ad5d-60c53ea3f45f"`
	vision := `{` + id + `,"flow":"xtls-rprx-vision"}`
	plain := `{` + id + `}`
	for _, fp := range []string{"chrome", "firefox", "safari"} {
		rs := `{"serverName":"example.test","fingerprint":"` + fp + `","publicKey":"UOYtBkamZWQ0UFKlSeRltak2gvt1kpm3NYtmXe0Xnic","shortId":"abcd"}`
		run("reality+vision+innerTLS "+fp, "reality", rs, 9400, vision, 9444, true)
		run("reality+vision+plain "+fp, "reality", rs, 9400, vision, 9445, false)
	}
	ts := `{"serverName":"example.test","allowInsecure":true}`
	run("tls+vision+innerTLS", "tls", ts, 9401, vision, 9444, true)
	run("tls+vision+plain", "tls", ts, 9401, vision, 9445, false)
	run("tls+noflow+plain", "tls", ts, 9402, plain, 9445, false)
	run("tls+noflow+innerTLS", "tls", ts, 9402, plain, 9444, true)
	bad := `{"serverName":"example.test","publicKey":"AQIDBAUGBwgJCgsMDQ4PEBESExQVFhcYGRobHB0eHyA","shortId":"abcd"}`
	run("reality wrong key (expect FAIL dial)", "reality", bad, 9400, vision, 9445, false)
}
